arxiv-2109-02534.title: Anomalous Optical Drag
arxiv-2109-02534.creator: Chitram Banerjee, Yakov Solomons, A. Nicholas Black, Giulia Marcucci, David Eger, Nir Davidson, Ofer Firstenberg, Robert W. Boyd
arxiv-2109-02534.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chitram Banerjee, Yakov Solomons, A. Nicholas Black, Giulia Marcucci, David Eger, Nir Davidson, Ofer Firstenberg, Robert W. Boyd. A moving dielectric medium can displace the optical path of light passing through it, a phenomenon known as the Fresnel-Fizeau optical drag effect. The resulting displacement is proportional to the medium’s velocity. In this article, we report on an anomalous optical drag effect, where the displacement is still proportional to the medium’s speed but along the direction opposite to the medium’s movement.

arxiv-2112-12456.title: Control of site occupancy by variation of the Zn and Al content in NiZnAl ferrite epitaxial films with low magnetic damping
arxiv-2112-12456.creator: Julia Lumetzberger, Verena Ney, Anna Zhakarova, Daniel Primetzhofer, Kilian Lenz, Andreas Ney
arxiv-2112-12456.description: Abstract The structural and magnetic properties of Zn/Al doped nickel ferrite thin films can be adjusted by changing the Zn and Al content. The films are epitaxially grown by reactive magnetron sputtering using a triple cluster system to sputter simultaneously from three different targets.

arxiv-2204-04758.title: Iceberg Sensemaking: A Process Model for Critical Data Analysis Thanks: Manuscript received TK; revised TK.
arxiv-2204-04758.creator: Charles Berret, Tamara Munzner
arxiv-2204-04758.description: Abstract We offer a new model of the sensemaking process for data analysis and visualization. Whereas past sensemaking models have been grounded in positivist assumptions about the nature of knowledge, we reframe data sensemaking in critical, humanistic terms by approaching it through an interpretivist lens.

arxiv-2209-01176.title: Statistical analysis of initial state and final state response in heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2209-01176.creator: Nicolas Borghini, Marc Borrell, Nina Feld, Hendrik Roch, Sören Schlichting, Clemens Werthmann
arxiv-2209-01176.description: Abstract We develop a general decomposition of an ensemble of initial density profiles in terms of an average state and a basis of modes that represent the event-by-event fluctuations of the initial state. The basis is determined such that the probability distributions of the amplitudes of different modes are uncorrelated.

arxiv-2210-00366.title: Nonlinear features of the superconductor–ferromagnet–superconductor φ 0 \varphi_{0} Josephson junction in ferromagnetic resonance region
arxiv-2210-00366.creator: Aliasghar Janalizadeh 1, Ilhom R. Rahmonov 2,3,4, Sara A. Abdelmoneim 5, Yury M. Shukrinov 2,3,4, Mohammad R. Kolahchi 1
arxiv-2210-00366.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aliasghar Janalizadeh 1, Ilhom R. Rahmonov 2,3,4, Sara A. Abdelmoneim 5, Yury M. Shukrinov 2,3,4, Mohammad R. Kolahchi 1. We demonstrate the manifestations of the nonlinear features in magnetic dynamics and IV-characteristics of the φ 0 \varphi_{0} Josephson junction in the ferromagnetic resonance region. We show that at small values of system parameters, namely, damping, spin-orbit interaction, and Josephson to magnetic energy ratio, the magnetic dynamics is reduced to the dynamics of the scalar Duffing oscillator, driven by the Josephson oscillations.

arxiv-2211-01052.title: Offline RL With Realistic Datasets: Heteroskedasticity and Support Constraints
arxiv-2211-01052.creator: Anikait Singh, Aviral Kumar, Quan Vuong, Yevgen Chebotar, Sergey Levine, EECS, UC Berkeley, Google Research {asap7772, aviralk}@berkeley.edu, quanhovuong@google.com
arxiv-2211-01052.description: Abstract Offline reinforcement learning (RL) learns policies entirely from static datasets, thereby avoiding the challenges associated with online data collection. Practical applications of offline RL will inevitably require learning from datasets where the variability of demonstrated behaviors changes non-uniformly across the state space.

arxiv-2304-10178.title: Noncollinear DFT+ U and Hubbard parameters with fully-relativistic ultrasoft pseudopotentials
arxiv-2304-10178.creator: Luca Binci, Nicola Marzari
arxiv-2304-10178.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Luca Binci, Nicola Marzari. The magnetic, noncollinear parametrization of Dudarev’s DFT+ U U method is generalized to fully-relativistic ultrasoft pseudopotentials. We present the definition of the DFT+ U U total energy functional, and the calculation of forces and stresses in the case of orthogonalized atomic orbitals defining the localised Hubbard manifold, where additional contributions arising from the derivative of the inverse square root of the overlap matrix appear.

arxiv-2306-08483.title: Simulation Study on Super-Resolution for Coded Aperture Gamma Imaging Thanks: The authors gratefully acknowledge the data storage service SDS@hd supported by the Ministry of Science, Research and the Arts Baden-Württemberg (MWK) and the German Research Foundation (DFG) through grant INST 35/1314-1 F
arxiv-2306-08483.creator: 1 st Tobias Meißner, 3 rd Jürgen Hesser, 2 nd Werner Nahm, 4 th Nikolas Löw
arxiv-2306-08483.description: Abstract Coded Aperture Imaging (CAI) has been proposed as an alternative collimation technique in nuclear imaging. To maximize spatial resolution small pinholes in the coded aperture mask are required. However, a high-resolution detector is needed to correctly sample the point spread function (PSF) to keep the Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem satisfied.

arxiv-2308-08535.title: Optimal spread for spanning subgraphs of Dirac hypergraphs
arxiv-2308-08535.creator: Tom Kelly, Alp Müyesser, Alexey Pokrovskiy
arxiv-2308-08535.description: Abstract Let G G and H H be hypergraphs on n n vertices, and suppose H H has large enough minimum degree to necessarily contain a copy of G G as a subgraph. We give a general method to randomly embed G G into H H with good “spread”.

arxiv-2401-14125.title: On the length of an arithmetic progression of the form 3 x + 2 y {3^{x}+2^{y}}
arxiv-2401-14125.creator: Hongnan Chen, Fenglin Huang, Sihui Zhang
arxiv-2401-14125.description: Abstract The conclusion that the length of an arithmetic progression of the form 3 x + 2 y {3^{x}+2^{y}} is at most six is proved. keywords arithmetic progression; representation. \ccode Mathematics Subject Classification 2020: 11D85, 11B25 1 Introduction The problem of a positive integers are represented as {3^{x}+2^{y}} has been an interestng topic in the theoretical study of mathematics.

arxiv-2411-07430.title: XPoint: A Self-Supervised Visual-State-Space based Architecture for Multispectral Image Registration
arxiv-2411-07430.creator: Ismail Can Yagmur, Hasan F. Ates, Bahadir K. Gunturk
arxiv-2411-07430.description: Abstract Accurate multispectral image matching presents significant challenges due to non-linear intensity variations across spectral modalities, extreme viewpoint changes, and the scarcity of labeled datasets. Current state-of-the-art methods are typically specialized for a single spectral difference, such as visible-infrared, and struggle to adapt to other modalities due to their reliance on expensive supervision, such as depth maps or camera poses.

arxiv-2411-11987.title: Hard X-ray and gamma-ray detectors
arxiv-2411-11987.creator: Vincent Tatischeff and Philippe Laurent
arxiv-2411-11987.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vincent Tatischeff and Philippe Laurent. Abstract Space-based astronomy of hard X-rays and gamma rays covers more than seven orders of magnitude in photon energy, from 10 keV to several hundred GeV. Detecting cosmic photons in this energy range is a challenge, due to the relatively low probability of interaction of high-energy photons with matter and the high background noise generated in space detectors by environmental charged particles and radiation.

arxiv-2502-01420.title: Origin of misleading convergence in self-consistent many-electron theories: Fundamental aspects and practical implications
arxiv-2502-01420.creator: Herbert Eßl, Matthias Reitner, Evgeny Kozik, Alessandro Toschi
arxiv-2502-01420.description: Abstract Self-consistent approaches in many-electron problems typically converge to an unphysical solution in strongly correlated regimes. By deriving the mathematical condition for the stability of the physical solution, we unveil the precise relation between two distinct issues previously considered equivalent: the misleading convergence in self-consistent schemes and the multivaluedness of the Luttinger-Ward functional.

arxiv-2502-06252.title: CliniQ: A Multi-faceted Benchmark for Electronic Health Record Retrieval with Semantic Match Assessment
arxiv-2502-06252.creator: Zhengyun Zhao, Hongyi Yuan, Jingjing Liu, Haichao Chen, Huaiyuan Ying, Songchi Zhou, Yue Zhong, Sheng Yu
arxiv-2502-06252.description: Abstract . Electronic Health Record (EHR) retrieval plays a pivotal role in various clinical tasks, but its development has been severely impeded by the lack of publicly available benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce a novel public EHR retrieval benchmark, CliniQ, to address this gap. We consider two retrieval settings: Single-Patient Retrieval and Multi-Patient Retrieval, reflecting various real-world scenarios.

pmc-10525862.title: Selected Acoustic Frequencies Have a Positive Impact on Behavioural and Physiological Welfare Indicators in Thoroughbred Racehorses
pmc-10525862.creator: Léa Gueguen, Séverine Henry, Maëlle Delbos, Alban Lemasson, Martine Hausberger
pmc-10525862.description: Simple SummaryRacehorses are submitted to stress-inducing practices that include restricted conditions of life and intensive racing training. This may impair their welfare and, as a consequence, their rider’s safety. Horses with compromised welfare may express stereotypic behaviors, aggressiveness or apathy, and may present abnormal hematological data. Agitation and lack of sleep may also lead to difficulties in physical recovery.

pmc-10674238.title: One-Shot Simple Pattern Detection without Pre-Training and Gradient-Based Strategy
pmc-10674238.creator: Jun Su, Wei He, Yingguan Wang, Runze Ma
pmc-10674238.description: One-shot object detection has been a highly demanded yet challenging task since the early age of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). For some newly started projects, a handy network that can learn the target’s pattern using a single picture and automatically decide its architecture is needed.

pmc-11336458.title: Transcriptomic analysis reveals cross-talk genes between type 2 diabetes and recurrent benign paroxysmal positional vertigo
pmc-11336458.creator: Jing Hui, Dingjing Zi, LePing Liang, Xiaoyong Ren
pmc-11336458.description: BackgroundBenign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) is a common neurological disorder with a high recurrence rate. Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is recognized as a risk factor for BPPV recurrence. However, the genomic association between T2DM and BPPV recurrence remains understudied.MethodsDifferential gene expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis were used to identify shared genes between BPPV recurrence and T2DM.

pmc-11622478.title: Sex differences in loneliness, social isolation, and their impact on psychiatric symptoms and cognitive functioning in schizophrenia
pmc-11622478.creator: Jinghui Chi, Nannan Liu, Tian Tian, Qiaona Jiang, Chenghao Lu, Yanzhe Li, Xiaofei Zhang, Yanyan Ma, Lili Wang, Shen Li
pmc-11622478.description: BackgroundSocial isolation and loneliness, objective and subjective features of dysfunctional social relationships, are more prevalent in patients with schizophrenia (SCZ) than in the general population. This study aimed to explore sex differences in loneliness and social isolation among Chinese chronic SCZ patients, and to investigate their relationships with psychiatric symptoms and cognitive functioning.

pmc-12466479.title: The Supersulfide-Producing Activity of Rat Cystathionine γ-Lyase Is Irreversibly Inactivated by L-CysNO but Not by L-GSNO
pmc-12466479.creator: Shoma Araki, Tsuyoshi Takata, Sunghyeon Yoon, Shingo Kasamatsu, Hideshi Ihara, Hidehiko Nakagawa, Takaaki Akaike, Yukihiro Tsuchiya, Yasuo Watanabe, Francisco J Corpas
pmc-12466479.description: Cystathionine γ-lyase (CSE) is a pyridoxal 5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme that catalyzes the final step of the transsulfuration pathway, converting cystathionine into cysteine. Additionally, CSE is also essential for the formation of cysteine hydropolysulfide (Cys-S-(S)n-H), known as supersulfides, by metabolizing cystine under pathological conditions. We previously reported that, during cystine metabolism, CSE undergoes self-inactivation through polysulfidation at the Cys136 residue.

pmc-12524078.title: Moral Distress in Ethical Dilemmas: A Comparative Study of Medical Students and Physicians
pmc-12524078.creator: George-Dumitru Constantin, Bogdan Hoinoiu, Ioana Veja, Crisanta-Alina Mazilescu, Teodora Hoinoiu, Ruxandra Elena Luca, Ioana Roxana Munteanu, Roxana Oancea, Susan Ka Yee Chow
pmc-12524078.description: Background: Ethical dilemmas and the moral distress they generate are central challenges in healthcare practice and professional identity formation. While moral reasoning has been widely studied, comparative evidence on how medical students and practicing physicians approach ethical dilemmas remains scarce in Eastern Europe.

pmc-12626334.title: Octopamine signaling regulates the intracellular pattern of the presynaptic active zone scaffold within Drosophila mushroom body neurons
pmc-12626334.creator: Hongyang Wu, Sayaka Eno, Kyoko Jinnai, Ayako Abe, Kokoro Saito, Yoh Maekawa, Darren W. Williams, Nobuhiro Yamagata, Shu Kondo, Hiromu Tanimoto, Taylor Hart, PhD, Taylor Hart, PhD, Taylor Hart, PhD
pmc-12626334.description: Neurons can adjust synaptic output according to the postsynaptic partners. However, the target-specific regulation of synaptic structures within individual neurons in the central nervous system remains unresolved. Applying the CRISPR/Cas9-mediated split-GFP tagging, we visualized the endogenous active zone scaffold protein, Bruchpilot (Brp), in specific cells.

pmc-12840628.title: Uncovering the Genetic Structure of the Sekler Population in Transylvania Through Genome-Wide Autosomal Data
pmc-12840628.creator: András Szabó, Zsolt Bánfai, Katalin Sümegi, Valerián Ádám, Ferenc Gallyas, Miklós Kásler, Béla Melegh
pmc-12840628.description: Background/Objectives: The Seklers are a Hungarian-speaking regional population in Transylvania, Romania, with a long and complex history, yet comprehensive genome-wide studies remain limited. Our aim was to characterize the genetic background of multiple Sekler communities using high-density autosomal data and to place them in a broader Central and Eastern European context.

pmc-13202913.title: Efficacy of lytic bacteriophages isolated from sewage-treatment plants in Mbarara district, Uganda against ciprofloxacin-resistant Salmonella Typhi in a mice infection model
pmc-13202913.creator: Phoebe N Bindyo, Ntulume Ibrahim, Jackim Nabona, Godswill J Udom, Jesca L Nakavuma
pmc-13202913.description: BackgroundResistance to antibiotics often leads to therapeutic failure and mortality, especially in resource-limited countries including Uganda. The study determined the in vivo efficacy of isolated lytic bacteriophages from sewage treatment plants, against ciprofloxacin-resistant Salmonella Typhi in Mbarara district, Uganda.MethodsA laboratory based experimental study was conducted.

pmc-13615320.creator: Maya Harel, Idan Nakdimon, Alon Itzkovitch, Oded Ben-Ari, Tom Schonberg
pmc-13615320.description: ObjectiveTo identify eye movement patterns that are correlated with spatial disorientation (SD) events during flights in a flight simulator that induces SD.BackgroundSpatial Disorientation is one of the main causes for aviation mishaps. uslaw-usc-t15-s1093.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 22 (Trademarks); Subchapter II (The Supplemental Register). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
